messages:
zoe: Brain dump - propose a compact policy matrix for tenant isolation: tier x impact -> actions. Keeping defaults conservative.
ken: Which signals? p99, host_cpu, queue_depth, error_rate, and cost_delta. Also request_type tag (streaming).
li: Actions: soft_steer -> reduce batch_size -> throttled queue -> quarantine/rehome. Each action has cooldown and hysteresis.
zoe: Hysteresis: require 2 consecutive breach windows for soft, 4 for hard; cooldown 10m. Default thresholds: p99>800ms(1m), error>0.5%(1m).
ken: Launch plan: alpha internal sims -> beta pilots (3 customers) -> GA. Must have telemetry, policy API, UI toggle and ops runbook.
li: Add per-tenant override + audit in Console. Pilot customers will need opt-in billing flag.
ops-bot: Note: warm-pool maintenance scheduled 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC. Avoid large rehomes around that time.
zoe: Action items: @ken build sim harness, @li mock Console overrides, I'll draft PRD + runbook. Goal: PRD by Tue, pilot in 3 sprints.
